easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two cards in hand.
Jolrael must not have summoning sickness.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Jolrael targeting yourself by paying {2}{G}, tapping it, and discarding two cards, causing all lands you control including Grove of the Burnwillows to become 3/3 creatures until end of turn.
Activate Marvin using Grove of the Burnwillows' ability by tapping it, adding {R} or {G} and causing each opponent to lose 1 life due to Tainted Remedy.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.
